tasks.title: Ground sync demand and settle the compatibility architecture
tasks.objective: Collect attributable public user evidence across Copper and comparable capture/notes tools, then decide how `.cue`, per-item Markdown and optional `.cue.md` interoperability coexist without a second live truth.
tasks.outcome: A reviewed architecture note in the feature proposal defines market-backed sync priorities, one authoritative compatibility direction, non-goals and transfer checks for CLI and iPhone consumers.
acceptance: Evidence distinguishes direct user statements from product-owner claims and implementation inference.
The `.cue` and `.cue.md` decision preserves fine-grained package sync and gives a plain-language compatibility explanation.
Sync requirements cover conflicts, offline behavior, deletion, attachments, privacy and mobile capture before naming a provider fallback.

verification.proves: The architecture, boundaries and market-backed requirements are explicitly reviewed.

tasks.title: Publish a coordinated schema-3 package and shared record codec
tasks.objective: Replace manifest membership and uncoordinated multi-file writes with directory-derived records, coordinated snapshot/CAS, staged atomic publication, revision-aware tombstones and one Foundation-only codec for package records and explicit cue.md import/export.
tasks.outcome: Schema-2 packages migrate only on a verified write; schema-3 packages are old-or-new at every failpoint, preserve unknown Markdown/frontmatter, reject unsupported writers and expose one API for app and future CLI/mobile consumers.
acceptance: Manifest contains workspace identity/schema/title but no authoritative item or section membership list.
Load document and revision fingerprint come from one coordinated snapshot; two writers with one expected revision produce exactly one winner.
A staged same-volume package is fully validated before atomic live replacement, and rollback never remove-then-copies the only valid package.
Tombstones bind observed record revision/hash rather than wall clock, and divergent edit/delete preserves both sides visibly.
Package-internal item records and external cue.md snapshots share one namespaced frontmatter codec while retaining non-Cue metadata and body bytes.

verification.proves: Snapshot, dual-writer, failpoint, migration, unknown-field and cue.md import/export contracts pass deterministically.

tasks.title: Implement recoverable content-addressed attachment closure
tasks.objective: Add platform-neutral PNG references and exact-byte blobs to schema 3 so Add, Remove, Archive, Undo, Recovery, Conflict Copy, safe merge, backups and delayed garbage collection preserve a complete verified asset closure.
tasks.outcome: Identical bytes deduplicate, every committed reference resolves or fails visibly, last-reference removal remains Undo-safe, and no crash or conflict path loses image bytes.
acceptance: Attachment metadata contains logical ID, exact-byte SHA-256, image/png, byte size and a strictly derived package-relative path without AppKit types.
Refcounts are derived from retained WorkItems; Archive, Undo, Recovery and conflict originals count as protected references.
Assets publish before referencing metadata; missing, corrupt, wrong-size, wrong-path and symlink cases return typed visible errors.
Conflict Copy, safe merge, backup and Undo materialize the exact asset closure, including locally staged bytes.
Physical deletion uses durable delayed candidates and cannot override a live/protected reference.

verification.proves: Attachment round-trip, dedup, shared delete, Undo, conflict closure, corruption and crash failpoints pass.

tasks.title: Implement explicit fail-closed region and window capture
tasks.objective: Use ScreenCaptureKit one-shot capture behind one invocation owner, Cue-owned region/window selection and pre-byte privacy gates with exact cancellation, permission and terminal restoration semantics.
tasks.outcome: A successful explicit command creates one verified attachment-backed WorkItem; cancel, denial, protected content, mapping failure, timeout, late callback and storage failure create zero asset and zero WorkItem.
acceptance: No screenshot API runs without a direct Region or Window command.
Window selection exposes window/PID/bundle identity before privacy gating; Region uses a Cue overlay and display-local sourceRect.
Accessibility denial, incomplete mapping, secure field, denylisted app and protected content fail closed before capture/encode/store.
One invocation epoch rejects concurrent, late and duplicate callbacks and restores panel/settings/focus exactly once.
No shell, private API, deprecated CGWindow capture, OCR, passive capture or continuous SCStream is introduced.

verification.proves: Capture success and every zero-byte terminal outcome pass through injectable owner seams.
The packaged app validates real Screen Recording permission, selection geometry and protected-app behavior.

tasks.title: Ship restrained preview, Copy Image, Drag File and Undo-safe Remove
tasks.objective: Extend only image WorkItems with a compact preview and accessible transfer/removal actions backed by the canonical stored PNG, without changing text-only density or leaking internal identifiers.
tasks.outcome: Image cards stay scanable at supported sizes; Copy Image and external file drag use verified bytes; missing assets remain visible; Remove is storage-owned and reversible.
acceptance: Text-only cards retain current spacing, height and interaction targets; image cards add one bounded preview and same-size missing placeholder.
Copy Image validates before touching the pasteboard, writes exact PNG then derived TIFF, and never clears user clipboard on preflight failure.
Drag File exposes public PNG plus an own-process reorder type, a readable suggested name and copy semantics without persistent temp files or UUID text leakage.
VoiceOver exposes one card with Copy/Remove actions and a real accessibility drag point; keyboard modifiers distinguish text, list and image copy exactly.
Remove calls the storage-owned reversible lifecycle and restores exact bytes through Undo.

verification.proves: Pasteboard, item-provider, accessibility, missing-asset, density and Undo contracts pass.
Copy into rich editors and long success/cancel drags into Finder behave correctly without panel retraction.

tasks.title: Adversarially qualify privacy, package integrity and exact runtime
tasks.objective: Challenge crash consistency, multi-writer conflicts, privacy, asset recovery, UI regressions and real transfer/capture behavior; repair root causes; package, restart, commit and push only closed slices.
tasks.outcome: All deterministic and packaged probes pass, residual two-Mac/provider work remains honestly scoped, and origin/main plus the running Cue process identify the exact delivered build.
acceptance: Warnings-as-errors, core, integration, Release render, package signing and Info.plist checks pass.
Adversarial review finds no passive capture, second source of truth, hybrid publication, dangling asset, premature GC or misleading sync claim.
Manual probes cover Screen Recording outcomes, region/window geometry, Copy Image, long drag success/cancel, minimum sizes, VoiceOver and edge retraction.
Each commit has one rollback boundary; Tracker, Goal and Researcher evidence are current; the signed dist app is restarted and pushed.

verification.proves: The complete deterministic behavior suite passes.
Platform permissions and cross-application transfers are repeatable.
Canonical task, gate and continuation evidence remain hash-bound.
